headline: Claims pertaining to Benefit Street and vehicle claims against the City of Pawtucket.
summary: The meeting will take up claims pertaining to Benefit Street and vehicle claims against the City of Pawtucket. A public input period comes first.
items: Claims pertaining to Benefit Street: Carrie Cardoso, $350.14 (tire); Courtney Petter, $623.12 (manhole); Ryan Boudreau, $374.71 (manhole); Timothy Pacheco III, $1,717.78 (vehicle damage); Karen Zapata, $1,172.50 / $2,029.80 (property damage)
Vehicle claims, City of Pawtucket: Sherry Marshall, $266.19 (tire); Cody Tavares by Progressive Subrogation, $1,301.83 (fire vehicle); Antonia Ramos & Gerson Dos Santos, $2,100.00 (vehicle damage)
location: Pawtucket Municipal Annex, 100 Freight Street, First Floor – City Council Conference Room - Room 140, Pawtucket, Rhode Island
